jobs.name: Morning event ingest + ship
jobs.prompt: Run the morning event pipeline. (1) `python /home/agent/.hermes/skills/business/event-ingest/ingest.py ingest` — pull every configured source into state/townloops.db. Per-source failures must not abort the run. (2) `python /home/agent/.hermes/skills/business/event-ingest/ingest.py ship` — POST/PATCH deltas to TownLoops. Emit a one-line JSON status with per-source and per-kind counts. Do NOT contact the operator unless a hard credential failure occurs.

jobs.name: Daily enrichment sweep (venue + business + performer)
jobs.prompt: Run the enrichment sweep. In sequence, execute: `venue-enrichment/enrich.py sweep --limit 20 --firecrawl`, then `venue-enrichment/enrich.py ship`, then the same pair for `business-enrichment` and `performer-enrichment`. Any single kind's failure must not stop the others. Emit a one-line JSON status with per-kind (claimed, filled, shipped, errors).

jobs.name: Evening event ingest + ship
jobs.prompt: Same as event-collect-am. Run ingest then ship; emit a one-line JSON status.

jobs.name: Sunday: compose the coming week's newsletter draft
jobs.prompt: Compute next week's ISO week (Mon-Sun ahead). Run `newsletter-weekly/newsletter.py compose --week <ISO>`. Read the draft body path from the JSON output; do NOT paste the whole HTML into Telegram. Send a summary: week label, event count, draft path, and a reminder that `push` requires operator approval. Do NOT push.

jobs.name: Sunday evening: nudge the operator to push the newsletter
jobs.prompt: Look up the current draft newsletter (this week's ISO week) via `newsletter-weekly/newsletter.py show`. If status is 'draft', message the operator with the exact `push --week <ISO>` command to run and ask for approval. If status is already 'scheduled' or 'sent', do nothing. Do NOT push without explicit operator instruction.

jobs.name: Monday: sponsor placement audit
jobs.prompt: Run `sponsor-management/sponsors.py audit`. Format the JSON as a short digest: (1) 'Expiring soon' — one line per ad_spot with placement + ends_at; (2) 'Unbound sponsors' — sponsors with no active placement. If both lists are empty, send a single line 'sponsors: all clear'. Do NOT take action; the operator drives assignments.
